newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stocks blue-chip index sinks 3 pct to below 950.
newsitem.headline: KL stocks blue-chip index sinks 3 pct to below 950.

text.p: Malaysia's blue-chip shares continued to plunge in late afternoon trading, with the Composite Index dipping below the key 950-point support level.
At 0736 GMT, the blue-chip index was down 3.01 percent, or 29.50 points, to 949.08.

Dealers said there was across the board selling by both local and overseas institutional investors, who were attempting to account for a string of announcements perceived as negative for the Malaysian economy.
Malaysia on Monday announced a 2.8 billion ringgit trade deficit for June, which analysts said was the biggest in any one month in at least 17 years.
On Sunday, the central Bank Negara announced a $2.0 million limit on swap transactions by Malaysian banks with any one overseas customer.
